PORT.description: HTTP server port. Must stay 8080 — it matches the Railway domain target port configured in this template.

FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__USERNAME.description: Username for the FreqUI web interface and REST API. Log in at / with this username and FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__PASSWORD.

FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__PASSWORD.description: Password for the FreqUI web interface and REST API (min 8 chars). Auto-generated per deployment — log in at / with username 'freqtrader'.

FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret used to sign API auth tokens (min 32 chars). Auto-generated per deployment.

FREQTRADE__API_SERVER__WS_TOKEN.description: Token for the FreqUI WebSocket connection (min 32 chars). Auto-generated per deployment.

FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__NAME.description: CCXT exchange id (kraken, binance, kucoin, gate, okx...). Kraken default works worldwide including US; binance is geo-blocked on some hosts.

FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY.description: Exchange API key — live trading only. Leave empty for dry-run paper trading.

FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__SECRET.description: Exchange API secret — live trading only. Leave empty for dry-run paper trading.

FREQTRADE__STRATEGY.description: Strategy class name from user_data/strategies/. Replace with your own strategy once uploaded via FreqUI or git.

FREQTRADE__DRY_RUN.description: Paper trading mode — simulated orders, no real funds. Keep true until your strategy is proven.

FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__ENABLED.description: Enable the Telegram control bot to manage your bot from chat.

FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Required when Telegram is enabled.

FREQTRADE__TELEGRAM__CHAT_ID.description: Your Telegram chat id for bot notifications. Required when Telegram is enabled.
